title: Who gets credit in the AI era? OpenAI maths bombshell sparks debate
title_zh: 谁能在 AI 时代获得认可？OpenAI 数学突破引发争议
abstract: Controversy around OpenAI’s claim to have solved the Navier–Stokes problem highlights how researchers could be inadvertently sharing — and absorbing — ideas through chatbots.
abstract_zh: 关于 OpenAI 声称已解决 Navier–Stokes 问题的争议，凸显了研究人员可能通过聊天机器人无意间共享并吸收想法的情况。
snippet: Controversy around OpenAI’s claim to have solved the Navier–Stokes problem highlights how researchers could be inadvertently sharing — and absorbing — ideas through chatbots.
